risks.title: Critical Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The risk is ranked as a top concern with dedicated governance at the Board and Audit Committee level. The language emphasizes the dynamic and frequent threat of significant incidents that could have disruptive and material impacts. Cybersecurity is highly weighted in the airline sector due to the criticality of information systems.

risks.title: Exclusive Dependence on Boeing
risks.score_rationale: Southwest relies entirely on Boeing as its sole aircraft manufacturer, operating an exclusive fleet of 803 Boeing 737s. Delivery delays or aircraft unavailability directly impact growth plans and fleet modernization. The risk is amplified by current FAA certification challenges.

risks.title: Aircraft Delivery Delays and FAA Certification
risks.score_rationale: Delays in 737-7 certification and delivery uncertainties threaten strategic fleet modernization plans. The filing uses strong language such as 'no assurances' and references risks of prolonged delays. This risk directly impacts expansion strategy and growth objectives.

risks.title: Fuel Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Fuel represents approximately 19% of operating expenses in 2025, exposing Southwest to significant vulnerability from geopolitical, environmental, and economic fluctuations. Fuel prices directly impact profitability even with minor market shifts.

risks.title: Military Pay Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The USERRA litigation is progressing with a tentative agreement in 2025 and an $18.5M fund. The risk is declining due to imminent resolution but remains significant from financial and operational perspectives. The impact is now quantifiable and controlled.

risks.title: Intense Airline Competition
risks.score_rationale: The airline industry is intensely competitive, with major rivals operating at similar or lower cost models. Southwest must maintain its historical low-cost advantage amid persistent competitive pressure and narrowing margins.

risks.title: Airport Capacity Constraints
risks.score_rationale: Airport capacity constraints and air traffic control inefficiencies have historically limited Southwest's potential growth. These external factors are beyond the company's control but directly impact growth strategies.

risks.title: Climate and Environmental Risks
risks.score_rationale: Southwest faces climate-related risks including extreme weather events disrupting operations and rising environmental compliance costs. Exposure is ongoing but managed within sustainability goals.

risks.title: Major Infrastructure Project at LAX
risks.score_rationale: The Concourse 0 project at LAX carries risks of budget overruns, delays, and financing challenges. The project extends to 2032 with a required budget deposit before 2028. The risk is significant but limited to one strategic station.

ai_positioning.summary: Southwest Airlines acknowledges its expanding use of artificial intelligence and machine learning in its 10-K filing, identifying risks related to regulatory compliance and AI risk management as critical areas requiring active oversight.
evidence: Explicit mention of expanding AI and machine learning use in the risk section
Identification of risks from AI strategy failure and regulatory non-compliance as materially harmful to operations and reputation
